about: P66 T1 dev set: 20 new English sentences, 4 per new genre (survivor, hole, steal, sort, arrows), each with a place and things from the sentence. Written 2026-10-28 before any P66 code change. Tuning on these is allowed.

sentences.text: a lone knight survives endless waves of skeletons in a ruined castle courtyard, picking a new power after every wave
a little robot auto-fires at swarms of space bugs on a moon base until the giant queen bug shows up
survive the zombie horde in an abandoned shopping mall for as long as you can
a hamster with a pea shooter holds out against hordes of angry cats in a messy kitchen
a black hole swallows the cars of a busy city
a hungry hole in the farmyard eats chickens, then tractors, then the whole barn
a sinkhole grows under a sunny beach and gulps down umbrellas, sandcastles and surfboards
a hole in the kitchen floor swallows plates and pots and finally the fridge
a raccoon sneaks into the rival camp, grabs their picnic basket and runs it back to his tree before the rangers catch him
steal the golden egg from the dragon's cave and carry it home to the village
a pirate crew raids the enemy ship for treasure chests and hauls them back to their own island
a ninja cat steals fish from the market stalls and brings them to her alley while guard dogs chase her
sort the colourful candies into the right jars in a sweet shop
a toy shop clerk puts teddy bears, robots and balls back on the right shelves
pour the coloured potions between bottles in a wizard lab until each bottle holds one colour
a mail sorter at the post office drops red, blue and yellow letters into the matching bags
clear the jammed parking lot by tapping each car so it drives out the way it points
a pile of arrows lies in a garden, tap them one by one so they fly off without hitting each other
untangle the traffic jam at a busy crossroads: tap a bus and it leaves if the road ahead is clear
slide the wooden fish out of the crowded pond, each fish only swims the way its nose points
